reply.text: {"say":"Back day built around your pull-ups first, then rows and a pulldown, with no direct biceps work, and we finish on shrugs for your traps.","title":"Back & Traps","days":[{"name":"Back","exercises":[{"key":"pull-up","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Full hang at the bottom, chest to the bar.\u00a0"},{"key":"barbell-bent-over-row","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Flat back, pull to the lower ribs."},{"key":"single-arm-cable-row","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Drive the elbow back, pause briefly."},{"key":"straight-arm-cable-pulldown","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Arms long, sweep down with the lats."},{"key":"reverse-pec-deck","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Lead with the elbows, slow return."},{"key":"dumbbell-shrug","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Straight up, hold the top for a second."}]}],"unmet":[]}
